title.narrative: Advancing Inclusive and Peaceful Electoral Foundations for Kenya’s 2027 Elections

description.narrative: This Project Initiation Plan (PIP) marks the first step to operationalize the UN’s October 2025 Electoral Needs Assessment Mission (NAM) recommendation to provide electoral assistance to Kenya. The NAM was triggered following the July 2025 reconstitution of the IEBC ahead of the 2027 elections. Accordingly, this PIP proposes a short to mid term, time bound package that preserves momentum while a multi year electoral assistance programme is designed and resourced. The PIP will focus on 3 immediate priorities: (i) institutional strengthening and public facing transparency of the IEBC; (ii) peaceful elections measures, including information integrity and Early Warning/Early Response; and (iii) inclusive participation with a youth focus. The PIP will pave way for scaling of interventions under an approved programme document. Implementation will lend to baseline information and tested interventions that transition into a broader electoral assistance programme. The PIP is accordingly designed to commence actions towards conflict mitigation, rebuild of public trust in democratic institutions and enhance informed participation, especially among first time voters. The intervention is fully aligned to SDG 16.
